subject.title: Feature Request: Image batching / media group buffering at gateway layer

question: Should the remaining media batching work be implemented as a plugin-owned opt-in buffer for LINE/WhatsApp-style channels, as a shared channel SDK/gateway media coalescer, or deferred in favor of existing text debounce plus narrow channel fixes?
rationale: The remaining behavior changes latency, public config shape, turn boundaries, replay/reply-token semantics, and plugin/core ownership, so automation should not choose the permanent product/API boundary.

options.title: Plugin-owned opt-in buffer
options.body: Implement sender/conversation-scoped media buffering in affected channel plugins first, using shared SDK helpers only where they clearly reduce duplication.

options.title: Shared SDK or gateway coalescer
options.body: Design a broader channel coalescing contract before channel-specific implementation, accepting a larger compatibility and API review.

options.title: Defer broad batching
options.body: Leave current text debounce and Telegram album behavior as supported, and address only narrower channel bugs such as WhatsApp steer media loss.

recommendation.title: Plugin-owned opt-in buffer
recommendation.body: Implement sender/conversation-scoped media buffering in affected channel plugins first, using shared SDK helpers only where they clearly reduce duplication.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision spans the shared debounce policy, plugin ownership, and config compatibility surfaces tied to steipete's recent history.
